title: Signal After Midnight
concept: An original adult radio engineer follows a mysterious midnight transmission through an abandoned coastal observatory and discovers that the signal is a message sent by her future self.

character.description: Mara is the same original 38-year-old South Asian woman in every character shot, with warm brown skin, a short dark bob under a plain mustard-yellow rain hood, a completely unmarked mustard-yellow rain suit, and brown work boots.

beats: The abandoned coastal observatory stands above the stormy ocean at midnight as its red radio beacon turns through the rain; no people are visible.
Inside the analog control room, Mara watches an old circular receiver glow to life.
A pulse of amber light travels along a thick brass cable from the radio tower toward the observatory dome; no people are visible.
Mara raises a simple brass compass as its needle turns toward the observatory visible through the rain-streaked window.
A compact utility van follows the wet cliff road toward the distant observatory; no driver is visible.
Mara stands alone at the chained observatory gate as the midnight pulse echoes from inside the dome.
Mara enters with a flashlight, revealing dust, salt-stained instruments, and a telescope frozen toward the horizon.
A row of dormant analog consoles with only round amber indicator lamps illuminates one by one as Mara walks deeper into the observatory.
Mara connects her portable receiver to an old patch panel and the dome machinery shudders awake.
The telescope rotates toward a patch of empty ocean rather than the night sky; no people are visible.
Mara hears her own voice emerge from the circular receiver and slowly reaches toward its pulsing amber light.
Mara notices seawater vibrating inside an old glass storm gauge as the level suddenly climbs toward a red marker.
A storm surge strikes the observatory seawall below the dome while the red beacon keeps turning; no people are visible.
Mara races through the dome and opens manual drainage gates as seawater climbs the cliff stairs.
Mara reroutes the transmitter through the telescope drive while controlled blue sparks scatter across the control room.
The observatory beacon broadcasts concentric amber evacuation pulses over the cliffs and stormy ocean; no people are visible.
Warm lights turn on in distant houses and a line of vehicles moves inland beneath the dark rain; no people are visible.
Mara watches a compass needle swing toward a safe hilltop as the receiver gives one final gentle pulse.
Mara reaches the hill and watches the first wave strike the empty observatory below while its red beacon keeps turning.
At dawn, Mara records a new message into the portable transmitter and completes the loop with a calm smile.
